reviewed_by: Claude review of phone-width critical workspace baselines
reason: area:critical-workspaces listed only the desktop and compact projects, so the narrow (390x844) renders of the same six workspaces were reconciled only in the full scope that playwright-impact.yml gates behind RUN_FULL_SUITE plus explicit approval. That scope does not run on pull requests, and the phone-width baselines had not moved since #190/#211: the Settings captures still showed the pre-#355 Setup/Advanced/Diagnostics tab strip instead of CompactSettingsList, and the rest still showed the pre-#355 Chat/Conversations/Activity/More companion nav that SessionsPage.tsx now renders as Chat/Terminal/Activity/More. Adding the narrow project to the area with the same "critical workspace|navigable panoramic shell" grep runs the same seven tests desktop and compact already run, so phone-width workspace renders are checked on every PR that maps to this area. Ten baselines are refreshed from this PR's own CI actuals (six dark, four light); reports-light and project-light already matched. The captures were byte-identical across all three CI attempts except workbench-light, which varied by two pixels. The 18 orphaned *-zero-light-*.png files are deleted: the only theme-interpolated capture is `${name}-${theme}.png` in "Light preserves each critical workspace hierarchy" and its loop is ["light"], so no test can emit a zero-light snapshot name.
exclusions: No Python, frontend or native tests: this change touches only the Playwright impact manifest and PNG baselines, no product or backend source. No mobile-chromium/mobile-webkit phone-shell entries: those projects capture different snapshot names and none of their baselines change. The desktop and compact critical-workspaces entries stay selected because the manifest edit and the deleted desktop/compact zero-light files sit in the same area, and both projects passed unchanged on the previous runs of this branch.
